description: Prices maid (helper) insurance for every featured insurer. The reply lists the Ministry of Manpower minimums under momMinimums. Each plan has its insurer, price in S$ with GST, the date the price was checked, excess, key cover limits and a buy link. Prices come from the broker's stored price tables for Singapore. No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

bondWaiver.description: Security bond waiver. "no" when not given.

country.description: The helper's home country. Read, but no insurer prices on it.

helperDob.description: Your helper's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

months.description: Cover period in months: 14 for a one-year work permit, 26 for two years.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.

renewal.description: "yes" when the helper's contract is being renewed, "no" for a new helper. Read and noted in the reply. The stored prices are the same for both.

waiver.description: The security bond waiver. With it, the insurer usually cannot ask the employer to repay the S$5,000 bond.
